purpose: Reusable real-agent prompt suite for testing CodeGraph MCP behavior on developer workflows.

tasks.intent: Study one feature deeply and explain how it works.
tasks.prompt: Use only CodeGraph MCP server codegraph-bench. Do not use shell/read/write/edit. Mandatory MCP calls: get_context_packet. Do not answer from prompt text alone; make the mandatory CodeGraph call before final JSON. Investigate review_patch end-to-end in src/v2/query/service.ts. Call get_context_packet for review_patch reviewTargets agentGuidance service.ts, then use returned toolHints or sliceHints with one batch get_file_slice call when exact source is needed. Return valid compact JSON only, no markdown, max 2600 chars, with keys: task,toolCallsUsed,batchSliceUsed,keyFiles,dataFlow,agentWorkflow,risks,glossary,confidence. Final JSON must include these exact repository-relative file path strings: src/v2/query/service.ts. Final JSON must include these exact terms somewhere in string values: review_patch, reviewTargets, agentGuidance.

qualityChecks: dataFlow describes input args, diff parsing, findings, reviewTargets, and requiredToolCalls
agentWorkflow explains how an agent should use reviewTargets before final review comments
glossary defines reviewTargets and agentGuidance

tasks.intent: Plan a code change across multiple modules without editing files.

You must call get_context_packet, not get_research_pack, for path delta watcher incremental refresh watcher indexer manifest sqlite. Then use returned toolHints or sliceHints with one batch get_file_slice call when exact source is needed. Return valid compact JSON only, no markdown, max 2800 chars, with keys: task,toolCallsUsed,batchSliceUsed,files,proposedApi,algorithm,concurrencyAndPerf,fullGraphCompleteness,testPlan,rollbackPlan,risks. Final JSON must include these exact repository-relative file path strings: src/v2/index/watcher.ts, src/v2/index/indexer.ts, src/v2/index/manifest.ts. Final JSON must include these exact terms somewhere in string values: watcher, indexer, manifest, full graph.

qualityChecks: algorithm distinguishes small path-delta refresh from large full refresh fallback
fullGraphCompleteness states that no files are skipped and fallback full refresh remains available
testPlan includes unit/integration coverage for changed, deleted, renamed, and branch checkout cases
